name: sparco-wave-v2
comment: R2 greeting: the full welcome spoken while the arm waves, then the arm goes down. The clip is over one 3s firmware chunk, so arm_dance streams it on a thread and the wave runs underneath it — hold is set to outlast the sentence so the arm is still up when it ends. 'release arm' is mandatory: the G1 holds its last pose forever, and a robot frozen mid-wave in front of guests is the failure mode.
